task_description:
# Agent Confidence Metrics

Display confidence scores for agent actions and decisions. Show users when the AI is uncertain and might need guidance. Allow setting confidence thresholds for automatic vs. human-approval workflows.

## Rationale
Addresses competitor pain points pain-1-1 (Cursor requires supervision) and pain-2-1 (Copilot passive). Provides a middle ground between full autonomy and constant oversight, building user trust in autonomous operations.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want to know when the AI is uncertain so that I can provide guidance on tricky decisions
- As a power user, I want to auto-approve high-confidence actions so that routine work proceeds without interruption

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each agent decision displays a confidence score (0-100%)
- [ ] Low-confidence actions are highlighted for user attention
- [ ] Users can set threshold for automatic vs. manual approval
- [ ] Confidence history is tracked to identify patterns
- [ ] Explanation is provided for why confidence is low

Basically an automated check to see if human needs to review. (if confidence is low)
